label: SCG I.22 necessary esse isolates conjunction contingency (inference)
rule: Unpack a world-indexed necessity and a contingent-union witness; preserve the same esse principle at the witness
meaning: Non-transcription structural consequence in a typed analyst profile: necessity of esse is separately quantified from contingent joining to q. The failed conjunction does not entail the failure of the esse; the no-necessity control shows the necessity condition matters. No attributed historical claim or metaphysical establishment is involved.
